title: NYRR 9+1 Membership Program — guaranteed entry pathway
claims: The 2026 9+1 program earns a non-complimentary, guaranteed entry to the 2027 TCS New York City Marathon: register for and complete nine qualifying races in 2026, volunteer at one +1 qualifying opportunity, and hold an active NYRR membership as of December 31, 2026.

The 2026 program lists more than 30 in-person races and three virtual races as eligible; the three virtual races are the Virtual Resolution Run 5K, Virtual NYRR Global Running Day 5K and Virtual NYRR Run for Thanks 5K, and virtual 9+1 credit requires the Premium tier at registration.

A 2026 9+1 entry applies only to the 2027 marathon; it is not rolled forward to 2028 or another future year, and a runner already entered into the 2027 marathon through another method cannot complete the 2026 program for 2027 or later eligibility.

Beginning with the 2027 9+1 Pass program (for 2028 guaranteed entry), access changes to a free-to-enter, member-only drawing: active NYRR membership by September 16, 2026 and through drawing day October 1, 2026; enter the drawing September 17–29, 2026; the drawing is held October 1, 2026; selected members are charged $99.00 including the processing fee and become 9+1 Passholders.

2027 Passholders must, in calendar year 2027, complete nine qualifying NYRR races, volunteer at one qualifying opportunity, and maintain active membership as of December 31, 2027 to earn non-complimentary guaranteed entry to the 2028 marathon.
